Cedar Ridge Dental — Family Dentist in Portland, OR

Cedar Ridge Dental is a family and cosmetic dental practice in Portland, Oregon, accepting new patients and most PPO insurance plans. Our team provides preventive cleanings, tooth-colored fillings, dental implants, clear aligners, and same-day emergency care from a single location on Cedar Road in the southwest of the city. Patients choose us because appointments start on time, treatment plans are explained in plain language before any work begins, and estimates are given up front with no surprise billing afterward. The practice has served the neighborhoods around Portland for more than fifteen years, and the same dentists see returning families year after year, which lets us track long-term oral health rather than treating each visit in isolation. Whether you need a routine six-month checkup, a crown, or urgent relief from a painful tooth, the fastest way to be seen is to call the office directly and describe your situation to the front-desk team. You can also read more about our team and history before your first visit.

Dental services we provide in Portland

Every treatment at Cedar Ridge Dental begins with a full examination and a written plan, so you understand what is recommended, why it matters, and what it will cost before you agree to anything. Preventive care is the foundation of everything we do, because catching a small cavity early is far cheaper and less invasive than restoring a tooth after it fractures. Our hygienists use digital X-rays that expose patients to a fraction of the radiation of older film systems, and every operatory is equipped for both routine and restorative work so most procedures can be completed without a referral elsewhere. For patients who feel anxious in the chair, we offer nitrous-oxide sedation and take the time to walk through each step. Families appreciate that children and adults can be scheduled back to back, turning two separate trips into one, and that we file insurance claims directly so reimbursement is not left to the patient to chase down after the appointment ends.

  • Preventive cleanings, exams, and digital X-rays
  • Tooth-colored fillings and same-visit crowns
  • Dental implants and bridges
  • Clear aligners and cosmetic whitening
  • Same-day emergency appointments
